## About this page

*Only in the desktop app.*

Checks for a newer version of WM Pass, and installs it when you choose.

#### How it works

A check asks GitHub for a small file that describes the latest release. Nothing is sent but the request itself, though GitHub sees it come from your address, as with any download.

Each release is signed. WM Pass refuses one whose signature does not match the key built into this app, so a release swapped on the way or on the server is not installed.

#### Limits

This page needs [Allow network features](/guide/settings/security/#setting-network-allowed).

See also [Check when WM Pass starts](/guide/settings/updates/#setting-update-check), [Allow network features](/guide/settings/security/#setting-network-allowed), [About](/guide/settings/about/).

<a id="setting-update-check"></a>

## Check when WM Pass starts

*Only in the desktop app.*

Checks for a newer version each time WM Pass starts, and tells you if there is one.

#### How it works

A message names the new version. Nothing is installed until you choose **Install and restart** here.

See also [Check now](/guide/settings/updates/#action-check-update), [Install and restart](/guide/settings/updates/#action-install-update).

<a id="action-check-update"></a>

## Check now

*Only in the desktop app.*

Asks GitHub whether a newer release is out. If there is one, its version and notes appear here.

See also [Install and restart](/guide/settings/updates/#action-install-update), [Check when WM Pass starts](/guide/settings/updates/#setting-update-check).

<a id="action-install-update"></a>

## Install and restart

*Only in the desktop app.*

Downloads the new version, checks its signature, installs it and restarts WM Pass.

#### Limits

Restarting closes WM Pass, so the vault locks and you unlock it again afterwards.

See also [Check now](/guide/settings/updates/#action-check-update), [Updates](/guide/settings/updates/).
